output.reason: [ev-8b0e88f56478] says PR 6682 undoes an earlier rename of a field in the run function protobufs, so the field is once again called `extra_resources`, the name "many functions in the ecosystem are expecting". [ev-c70532147f60] is only a one-line note. Neither says whether the earlier rename (commit 782cc67) was ever in a release before 2.0.0, and neither gives the name the field was renamed to. If the rename never shipped, 2.0.0 keeps the wire name unchanged from the previous release, and "behavior-changed" would claim a change that did not happen. To decide subject and change, we need to know which releases included that commit and what the replaced field name was.
